title: [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois..., pages 650 bis à 787, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: No mathematical error. Implicit assumption: M is abelian, which is needed for Aff(E) = M ⋊ Aut(M) and for the bottom row to be exact. The middle-arrow notation is written ambiguously (theta with a heavily scribbled subscript); it should be the homomorphism defined on M~.

ideas.what: Elements of an extension M~ of Gamma by M acting on an M-torseur act by affine maps, giving a morphism of extensions into Aff(E) = M ⋊ Aut(M).
ideas.modern_name: Morphism of group extensions into the holomorph / affine group of a torsor
ideas.where_published: Similar torsor/extension formalism appears in SGA 1 and SGA 7 and in Giraud's nonabelian cohomology; this specific page is unpublished.

ideas.what: The lifting exists iff the extension class in H^2(Gamma, M) vanishes; solutions form a Z^1-torsor, with classes up to conjugacy given by H^1.
ideas.modern_name: Splittings of group extensions classified by H^1; obstruction in H^2
ideas.where_published: Standard; used throughout SGA 1 and the Tohoku paper context

deep.surprise_reason: Routine translation of a lifting problem for covers into the standard H^2-obstruction / H^1-classification of splittings of an extension. It is careful bookkeeping within the Longue Marche, not new mathematics.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'Donc si on introduit le groupe Aff(E), on a un homomorphisme de suites exactes'. The top middle term of (281) is M~ (with scribbles), and the middle vertical arrow is theta_{M~}, not theta_{Gamma~}.

'où les flèches verticales extrêmes id_M et theta_Gamma sont connues, et où la flèche médiane est à déterminer. On peut dire que les catégories des X' cherchés (avec l'op. de Gamma dessus satisfaisant aux conditions voulues) est équivalente à celle des couples (E, theta_{M~}), où E est un M-torseur, et theta_{M~} un homomorphisme de groupes M~ -> Aff(E) compatible avec id_M et theta_Gamma'.

End of page: 'On peut dire aussi, une fois E choisi (et ce choix est unique à isomorphisme non unique près!) que cela définit une extension Aff(E) de Aut(M) par M, d'où via theta_Gamma: Gamma -> Aut(M) une extension...' Here 'grâce' should read 'que'; 'en question' should read 'via' (reading uncertain).
